summary: Frontend voice-message UX end-to-end test for StudioChatWidget (timer + preview + mobile). Logged in as studio1@test.com, opened widget, injected fake AudioContext MediaStream via addInitScript so getUserMedia/MediaRecorder work headlessly. Verified: recording bar appears with live timer that increments (0:00 -> 0:01 -> 0:02), stop -> preview bar appears with player/send/discard, message is NOT auto-sent, send posts audio and it appears as <audio> in message list, discard removes preview without sending, normal input bar returns each time, mobile 390x844 layout for panel/recording bar/preview bar do not overflow horizontally. FAILURE: chat-rec-cancel while recording DOES produce a preview (bug in cancelRec). Text send flow not reached because script aborted at cancel assertion.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking chat-rec-cancel while recording still shows the audio preview bar (screenshot confirms). Requirement says cancel must stop recording and return directly to the normal input bar WITHOUT any preview. Root cause: cancelRec() calls recRef.current.stop(), which fires MediaRecorder.onstop; that handler unconditionally builds a Blob/File/objectURL and calls setPreview({url,file,secs}). setRecording(false) in cancelRec cannot suppress it because onstop is async and does not check any 'canceled' flag.

action_items: Fix cancelRec so no preview is created. Suggested patch: add a canceledRef (useRef(false)); in cancelRec set canceledRef.current = true before calling recRef.current.stop(); in the onstop handler, if canceledRef.current is true, skip URL.createObjectURL / setPreview and reset canceledRef.current=false. Also ensure recSecs is reset and recording flag cleared (already done).
critical_code_review_comments: cancelRec relies on MediaRecorder.stop() but onstop always sets preview - needs cancel-aware flag.
In onstop, setRecSecs callback used to capture secs into preview is a functional trick; acceptable but consider using a ref for clarity.
pickAudioMime / mimeExt logic looks correct for iOS Safari fallback (audio/mp4 -> m4a).
seed_data_creation: One TEST audio message was posted to /api/studio/chat during the send test (attach_kind=audio). No cleanup performed - matches previous iteration pattern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice recording preview + timer + mobile layout + send + discard flows all PASS. Only the cancel-while-recording flow fails because onstop unconditionally builds a preview. After fix, re-run the same script (fake MediaStream via addInitScript + grant_permissions('microphone')). Text-send verification and mobile preview overflow check were not executed because the script threw at the cancel assertion — re-run once cancel is fixed.
rca of the issue: MediaRecorder.stop() always fires onstop asynchronously; the onstop callback in StudioChatWidget.jsx (lines 103-113) always calls setPreview(...) regardless of whether the user hit Stop or Cancel. cancelRec sets setRecording(false)/setRecSecs(0) synchronously but that runs before onstop, so preview state is overwritten to non-null right after. Fix by tracking intent via a ref (e.g. canceledRef) and gating setPreview in onstop.
